mapper.insert: INSERT INTO petcare.proveedor (persona_id, usuario_id, latitud, longitud, radio_cobertura_km, descripcion, verificado, calificacion) VALUES (#{personaId}, #{usuarioId}, #{latitud}, #{longitud}, #{radioCoberturaKm}, #{descripcion}, #{verificado}, #{calificacion})
mapper.select: SELECT pr.id, pr.persona_id, pr.usuario_id, pr.latitud, pr.longitud, pr.radio_cobertura_km, pr.descripcion, pr.verificado, pr.calificacion, pr.created_at, pr.updated_at, pr.deleted, pr.version FROM petcare.proveedor pr WHERE pr.id = #{id} AND pr.deleted = FALSE

SELECT pr.id, pr.persona_id, pr.usuario_id, pr.latitud, pr.longitud, pr.radio_cobertura_km, pr.descripcion, pr.verificado, pr.calificacion, pr.created_at, pr.updated_at, pr.deleted, pr.version FROM petcare.proveedor pr INNER JOIN petcare.proveedor_especialidad pe ON pe.proveedor_id = pr.id AND pe.deleted = FALSE INNER JOIN petcare.servicio s ON s.id = pe.servicio_id AND s.deleted = FALSE WHERE pe.servicio_id = #{servicioId} AND pr.deleted = FALSE ORDER BY pr.created_at ASC

SELECT pr.id, pr.persona_id, pr.usuario_id, pr.latitud, pr.longitud, pr.radio_cobertura_km, pr.descripcion, pr.verificado, pr.calificacion, pr.created_at, pr.updated_at, pr.deleted, pr.version, (6371 * acos( cos(radians(#{latitud})) * cos(radians(pr.latitud)) * cos(radians(pr.longitud) - radians(#{longitud})) + sin(radians(#{latitud})) * sin(radians(pr.latitud)) )) AS distancia FROM petcare.proveedor pr WHERE pr.deleted = FALSE AND pr.latitud IS NOT NULL AND pr.longitud IS NOT NULL AND (6371 * acos( cos(radians(#{latitud})) * cos(radians(pr.latitud)) * cos(radians(pr.longitud) - radians(#{longitud})) + sin(radians(#{latitud})) * sin(radians(pr.latitud)) )) <= #{radioKm} ORDER BY distancia ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT pr.id, pr.persona_id, pr.usuario_id, pr.latitud, pr.longitud, pr.radio_cobertura_km, pr.descripcion, pr.verificado, pr.calificacion, pr.created_at, pr.updated_at, pr.deleted, pr.version FROM petcare.proveedor pr WHERE pr.usuario_id = #{usuarioId} AND pr.deleted = FALSE
mapper.update: UPDATE petcare.proveedor SET persona_id = #{personaId}, usuario_id = #{usuarioId}, latitud = #{latitud}, longitud = #{longitud}, radio_cobertura_km = #{radioCoberturaKm}, descripcion = #{descripcion}, verificado = #{verificado}, calificacion = #{calificacion}, updated_at = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE
UPDATE petcare.proveedor SET deleted = TRUE, updated_at = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
